title: Build Grave Accord with 66 bosses, Crazed forms and class upgrades
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements 66 boss identities (65 ordinary plus one secret), seven classes, 378 skills/63 paths, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This is unfinished feature-branch development; PR #14 remains draft and main stays protected.

Carrion Courier now makes one/two Standard deliveries across its half-health phases; advanced forms add one leg and a fully warned split fan. Every leg locks its warning from the actual previous stop. Collision-resolved fading trails, a shared contact budget, clear recovery and retained cross volleys make the phase change mechanical without raising its Standard health/damage. Fifteen-locale help and actual owner/observer route replication are covered. This is the third original-roster quality implementation;57 remain, human acceptance open. Exact current evidence is under reviews/courier-route-2026-10-26/.

Corner retreat made the weak opening bosses easy to disengage from. Four spacious maps now have smaller real footprints with identical transforms for paint, colliders and spawns; Ossuary/Crown retain their narrow routes. Player speed, dash distance and Normal boss health stay unchanged. The boss header separates name, grade/form, phase and timer. A distinct original priority phase bell and restrained reduced-motion-aware entry animation clarify changes.

All 66 identities now admit purple Crazed/C forms inheriting their full Brutal signatures. Insane forces Brutal; Hellish forces Crazed throughout openings, offers, repeats and the consented secret. Ordinary projectile budgets are 2.5x for Brutal and 7.5x for Crazed, with fixed warned trajectories and bounded work/4,000live cap. Controlled clock/drone shots retain stop/resume/source cancellation. Brutal adds warned pursuit marks/crosscuts; Crazed adds faster pressure and a delayed perpendicular weave. Warden active cones retain clear trailing space. Crazed adds mechanics rather than another health multiplier; no instant-kill attacks are included.

Endless records each actually cleared form and advances Standard→Brutal→Crazed. Protocol22 additionally preserves protocol21 completed form history and retains known issued protocol20 local Practice/profile identity, money, purchases and progress while online/signed state remains strict. Baby/Easy/Normal combat revival remains 100%/50%/25%, Hard+ disabled. Baby/Easy Standard retain six/three shield circles with two/three-second holds; advanced forms have none. Baby extra cover, Hard half, Insane/Hellish no interior cover and Hellish lava remain.

Early Watch and Small Wakes remain six integrated original encounters with 72 selected poses, individual scores and fifteen-locale help. Previous native artwork/music deliveries remain unchanged. Courier receives the individual route pass described below; the other65 identities retain their complete definitions. Seven ability-upgrade revamps/21 transforms and the optional all 54 skill map are implemented. Profiles/mastery/cosmetics/remaps, all five modes and the bank-safe secret remain.

Validation: 510 automated tests, authored content/fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass. A separate actual-Game audit covers 3,876 phase/form/map combinations around initial casts; 13 new regressions cover actual density, controlled behaviors, warning/contact/cancellation, Warden safety, 250-clear Endless restore, known local migration and real owner/observer pressure/phase-sound replication. The declared 15,834-row offensive feasibility model has zero deadline misses. Exact current source/production/CI/publication and failed-attempt evidence is under reviews/courier-route-2026-10-26/; the earlier Crazed checkpoint remains preserved separately. Thirteen Courier regressions additionally cover sequential routes, wall stops, swept contact, dispatch density, cleanup, migration and actual two-client replication.

The roster target still needs 85 new ordinary identities and 57 individual original-roster quality passes. Human 5185 comparison confirmed clearer phase/Brutal differences but identified excessive retreat space; current changes await comparison. Rendered animation, boss/special-ability art, native-language/listening/device/final balance, mixed-progression/WAN/full endurance, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release remain open. Multiple-boss encounters and bespoke transformation animations remain future work.

Canonical Wiki remains 18 pages / 34 unchanged images, with exact committed publication and public hash verification separate from source pushes. All frozen previews are preserved. The public protocol 4 Site and immutable protocol 13 Windows development archive remain separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
